AWAKENED-SPELLBOOK_FTUE.title: The Spellbook
AWAKENED-SPELLBOOK_FTUE.description:
Cards with [gold]Conjure[/gold] pull the next [gold]Spell[/gold] card from your [gold]Spellbook[/gold] into your hand.
Hover over it to see which spell is lined up next.
AWAKENED-AWAKEN_FTUE.title: The Awaken Meter
AWAKENED-AWAKEN_FTUE.description:
Playing a [gold]Power[/gold] fills this meter.
Play [blue]7[/blue] [gold]Powers[/gold] to [gold]Awaken[/gold].
Once [gold]Awakened[/gold] all your [gold]Spell[/gold] cards are [gold]Upgraded[/gold]
